content: What do you want from me? Speak clearly.
I'm trying to understand why you've been pushing me so hard to deliver that information.
Because if you don't hand it over soon, things won't just be difficult for you, they'll get dangerous. You don't want to test my patience.
Look, I'm working on it, but I need more time. Threatening me won't speed anything up.
More time? That's not an option anymore. If this drags out, I promise you'll regret the consequences.
I'm telling you, I want to avoid any trouble. Let's find a way to sort this without escalating.
Avoiding trouble? You're already deep in it. If you don't come through, I won't hesitate to make an example out of you.
Please, just tell me what you need exactly, and I'll get it done. No one has to get hurt.
You better be ready to deliver exactly what I want, and fast. Because if you fail me, that's on you.
